Location The property occupies a prominent position within the idyllic village setting of Mowsley, within the heart of the South Leicestershire countryside. The premises provide an excellent opportunity for an incoming purchaser to acquire a turnkey butchery business premises, with the existing fixtures, fittings and equipment included within the sale. The ground floor provides a front serving and retail area, together with a rear preparation room and dedicated refrigeration area. The first floor comprises a staff rest room, kitchenette, WC and separate office. The property may also offer potential for alternative commercial use or mixed-use/residential conversion, subject to obtaining all necessary planning consents and statutory approvals. An attractive opportunity for an owner-occupier, existing butcher or food-related business, investor or developer seeking a well-positioned freehold commercial property in central Beccles. Location 3A Market Street is centrally located within the popular Suffolk market town of Beccles, situated close to the town centre’s established retail, commercial and leisure amenities. Beccles benefits from a strong local catchment and regular footfall, with a variety of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and professional services nearby. The town is well connected by road, with the A146 providing access towards Norwich and Lowestoft, while Beccles railway station offers regular services to Ipswich and Norwich. The surrounding Waveney Valley and nearby Suffolk Heritage Coast further enhance the area’s appeal. Tenancy Vacant possession Tenure Freehold Accommodation Ground Floor: Front serving/retail area. Rear: Preparation room with dedicated refrigeration area. First Floor: Staff rest room and kitchenette. First Floor: WC and separate office. Two-storey commercial accommodation with existing butchery fit-out and equipment. The office accommodation is arranged across the ground and first floor and provides a mix of cellular and open plan space, with WC's and kitchenette facilities, totalling approximately 1,397.60 sq m (15,044 sq ft). Externally, the property benefits from 43 parking spaces and is on a site of approximately 0.228 hectares (0.564 acres). Location The property is located at Northbrook Industrial Estate, within an established industrial area in the north-west of Southampton, approximately 4 miles from the city centre. The estate forms part of a well established employment location, predominantly comprising light industrial and warehouse units, supporting a range of trade, logistics and commercial occupiers. The site benefits from excellent transport connectivity, with easy access to the M271 and M27, which in turn provide links to the M3 motorway. This enables convenient access to Southampton, Winchester, Portsmouth and the wider South Coast. Southampton Airport Parkway railway station is located approximately 3 miles to the north-east, offering regular services to London Waterloo and other destinations. The surrounding area includes a mix of industrial estates, business parks and residential neighbourhoods, with nearby occupiers including Nursling Industrial Estate and Adanac Park. There are also nearby green spaces and recreational areas, including Lordswood and the River Test. Tenure The property is held Freehold under Title Numbers HP240698 and HP263573. We understand the titles are subject to a flying freehold. the Vendor has confirmed they will offer a flying freehold indemnity policy to the successful purchaser on completion. Tenancy The sale of the property is subject to a sale and leaseback arrangement, on the following terms: The property will be let for a term of 12 months at a rent of £117,465 per annum from a date TBC. The lease will be contracted out of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 and will include a tenant break option at month 9, subject to 3 months’ notice. The tenant’s repairing obligations will be limited in accordance with an agreed Schedule of Condition. Further details will be included in the Legal Pack. The lease back to the seller is to be granted simultaneously on completion of the sale. properties.address: Unit 12A Cobalt Business Park, Silver Fox Way, Cobalt Park, Newcastle Upon Tyne, NE27 0QJ
properties.description: The property comprises a detached Grade A office building of steel frame construction arranged over four storeys. Internally, the accommodation is arranged to provide open plan office floor plates around a full height atrium reception. The specification includes air conditioning, raised access floors, LED lighting and approximately 3 metre floor to ceiling heights, together with lift access to all floors. The total accommodation extends to approximately 5,263.65 sq m (56,657 sq ft) NIA, with typical floor plates extending to 1,303.99 sq m (14,036 sq ft). Externally, the property benefits from approximately 254 car parking spaces. Location The property is located at Cobalt Business Park within the borough of North Tyneside, approximately 6 miles north east of Newcastle city centre. The property is situated on one of the UK’s largest business parks, within a well established commercial and office environment. Cobalt Business Park accommodates a number of major occupiers including Accenture, EE, HP, Sage Group Plc and North Tyneside Council. The park also benefits from a range of on-site facilities including the CobaltCentral retail hub, a Busy Bees day nursery, and the Newcastle Village Hotel & Leisure Club. The location is well connected, providing transport links via the A19, enabling direct access to the wider North East region, as well as connections to the A1(M) and the Tyne Tunnel. Public transport is available from Northumberland Park Metro station, which offers services to Newcastle city centre, the coast and Newcastle International Airport. The surrounding area is predominantly commercial in character, supported by nearby retail and leisure provision at Silverlink Retail Park. Tenure The property is held Leasehold under Title Number TY365181. Tenancy We understand that a parking licence is in place for 100 spaces, which are currently let to the NHS at a rent of £96,000 per annum. The licence commenced 6 years ago and is subject to annual renewal on 31 August, it is expected this will continue. properties.address: Thurrock Business Centre, 2 & 4 George Street, Grays, Essex, RM17 6LY
properties.description: The property comprises a detached freehold office building currently utilised as a business centre. The accommodation extends to approximately 678.90 sq m (7,307 sq ft) GIA and is arranged to provide office and ancillary accommodation. The building is understood to have formerly been used as a Post Office and retains a number of character features. The property is not understood to be listed. Externally, gated private car parking is provided to the rear. The total site extends to approximately 0.095 hectares (0.235 acres). The property occupies a position just off the High Street, adjacent to a Morrisons supermarket and opposite the former cinema site, where a planning application is understood to be pending for hotel use. Location Thurrock Business Centre is situated on George Street in Grays, Essex, approximately 0.3 miles to the north of Grays town centre. The surrounding area comprises a mix of retail, commercial, and residential uses. Grays railway station is located approximately 100m to the south, providing rail services to London Fenchurch Street. The property is also within proximity to the A13, which provides access east towards Southend-on-Sea and west towards the London Docklands and the City. The M25 (Junction 30) lies approximately 2.5 miles to the west, providing connections to the national motorway network. Local amenities are available within Grays town centre, including retail, banking and food outlets. Bus services operate along nearby routes, providing connections to surrounding areas within Thurrock. Tenure Freehold under Title Number EX757302. Tenancy The property is let to NWES Property Services Limited by way of a renewal lease dated 18 December 2025 for a term from 21 December 2025 to 31 July 2027. The lease is contracted outside the security of tenure provisions of sections 24–28 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954. The rent is calculated by reference to the lease provisions and is understood to comprise 90% of Operating Profits, with the tenant required to provide annual accounts detailing revenue, permitted costs, outgoings and any operating profit or loss. The permitted use is as a business centre / offices within Use Class E. Internally, the ground floor comprises an open plan bar area with a raised stage area and an additional rear bar, with a capacity for 150 standing, together with WC’s and ancillary storage rooms. The basement offers a beer cellar and further large storage areas. The upper floors provide owners’ accommodation comprising five bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with an en-suite, a kitchen with a small utility area, lounge / large office space, two shower rooms with WC’s and an additional bathroom. Totalling approximately 406 sq m (4,370 sq ft) GIA. Externally, the property benefits from a small smoking area to the rear. The property sits on a site of approximately 0.023 hectares (0.057 acres). Location The property is located on Malden Road in the London Borough of Camden, positioned on a prominent corner within a well established mixed-use area in the NW5 district. The surrounding locality comprises a mixture of residential properties, independent retailers, public houses and local amenities, benefiting from strong footfall and a vibrant neighbourhood setting. Malden Road provides direct access to Kentish Town, Chalk Farm and Camden Town, all within close proximity, offering a wide range of retail, leisure and transport facilities. Camden Town, approximately 0.8 miles to the south, is a well-known commercial and tourist destination. The property is well connected by public transport, with Kentish Town West (London Overground) located approximately 0.3 miles to the south-east and Kentish Town Underground Station (Northern Line) approximately 0.5 miles to the east, providing regular services into Central London. Numerous bus routes also serve the area. Road communications are strong, with easy access to the A400 and A1, providing routes into Central London and northwards towards the M1. Internally, the property provides commercial accommodation at ground and first floor level, formerly utilised as a coffee shop and café/bar, together with ancillary accommodation. The first and second floor provide residential accommodation comprising approximately 13 bedrooms and associated living space. The combined property extends to approximately 539.68 sq m (5,809 sq ft) GIA. Externally, the property includes a front seating area, enclosed rear yard, and a detached double garage. The property sits on a site of approximately 0.041 hectares (0.102 acres). Location The property is located on Marine Road Central in Morecambe, within the City of Lancaster district in Lancashire. Morecambe is a well established coastal town on the eastern shores of Morecambe Bay, situated approximately 3 miles west of Lancaster and 28 miles north of Preston. The property occupies a prominent seafront position, benefitting from open views across Morecambe Bay towards the Lakeland Fells. The location is undergoing ongoing regeneration, including the proposed Eden Project North, which is expected to further enhance the town’s profile and increase visitor numbers. properties.address: Former Colt International Site, New Lane, Havant, Hampshire, PO9 2SL
properties.description: The site was formerly occupied by Colt International and was acquired by Homes England in 2017, who later instructed the subsequent demolition and remediation work on site. The site has since been left cleared and levelled. The total site area extends to approximately 0.781 hectares (1.929 acres). Location The Former Colt International Site is prominently located at the junction of New Lane and Bartons Road on the established North Havant Industrial Estate, benefitting from strong frontage and excellent access to the surrounding employment area. Havant is a busy and densely populated town in South East Hampshire, situated approximately 6 miles north‑east of Portsmouth and around 12 miles west of Chichester, with a borough population understood to be in excess of 120,000. The site is approximately 1.5 miles north of the A27 at Langstone, providing swift connectivity to the strategic road network, including the A3(M) and M27 via the Broadmarsh Interchange, providing convenient access along the South Coast and northwards towards Guildford, the M25 and London. Havant town centre and the mainline railway station are a short drive to the south, providing regular direct services to London Waterloo (typically around 75–76 minutes). Portsmouth International Port and the Royal Navy Dockyard are also within an approximate 15‑minute drive of the site. The location benefits from a large and skilled labour pool, with a range of established occupiers in the wider area, including Eaton Aerospace, Amazon and Kenwood De’Longhi. Tenure The site is held Freehold under Title Number HP26714. Planning The site previously benefited from outline planning consent for up to ten new business units totalling approximately 2,860 sq m (30,785 sq ft). This formed part of a wider mixed‑use planning application (ref. APP/18/00244), which also permitted up to 100 residential units on adjoining land. The outline consent was granted on 30 January 2019. Following subsequent reserved matters approval, the residential phase has now been developed. The original outline planning permission has now lapsed, and interested parties should therefore make their own enquiries in respect of any future development potential for the employment land. properties.address: Flat 1, 1-3 Manson Place, London, Kensington and Chelsea, SW7 5LT
properties.description: The property comprises a self contained one bedroom basement flat forming part of a larger period residential building. The property is of traditional masonry construction beneath a flat roof. Internally, the accommodation comprises a living room, kitchen, one bedroom, and bathroom facilities arranged across a single basement level, extending to approximately 90 sq m (969 sq ft) (area taken from the EPC). Externally, the property has on street parking to the front. Location The subject property is located in South Kensington, within the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, one of London's most affluent and highly sought after residential districts. South Kensington is situated approximately 2.5 miles west of Central London and is renowned for its period architecture, cultural attractions, prestigious educational institutions, and prime residential accommodation. The property is positioned within a predominantly residential area characterised by apartments, terraced houses, embassies, hotels, and luxury retail and leisure amenities. The locality benefits from excellent access to a wide range of shops, restaurants, cafés, and everyday services along Old Brompton Road, Cromwell Road, and Fulham Road. The world-renowned Natural History Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, and Science Museum are all within a short walk of the property, whilst Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens are located approximately 0.5 miles to the north. Knightsbridge, including Harrods and Harvey Nichols department stores, lies approximately 1 mile east of the property. South Kensington Underground Station is located approximately 0.25 miles south-east of the property, around a 5-minute walk away, providing services on the Circle, District, and Piccadilly Lines. These routes offer direct access to key London destinations including Westminster, Victoria, King's Cross St Pancras, and Heathrow Airport. Gloucester Road Underground Station is also within walking distance, approximately 0.40 miles west of the property. Numerous bus routes operate along Cromwell Road and Old Brompton Road, providing further public transport connections across Central London. The property also benefits from excellent road connectivity, with the A4 Cromwell Road located approximately 0.25 miles north, providing direct access to Central London to the east and Heathrow Airport and the M4 motorway to the west. The A308 and A3220 offer links to Chelsea, Kensington, and the wider London road network. properties.description: Elen's Castle Hotel comprises an 18th century coaching inn of traditional construction, providing 14 bedrooms in total, along with a former coach house/stables. Internally, the ground floor contains the principal public areas comprising a breakfast and garden room/restaurant, for approximately 30 covers and a separate bar and lounge. The ground floor also provides a catering kitchen, preparation kitchen, walk‑in fridge, laundry room, office, storage area and an owners living room. The first floor comprises 8 en-suite units including, 6x double bedrooms, 3x bedroom family suite, 1x twin bedroom and a 3x bedroom owners room across the first and second floor. Along with an additional laundry room, storage and WC's. The coach houses/stables also provides an additional 1x bedroom bunk house and a secure indoor motorbike and bicycle storage area, extending to approximately 447 sq m (4,811 sq ft) GIA. Externally, the property benefits from grounds and gardens with an outside seating area for approximately 20 covers, a former Roman Well is also located on site providing spring water. There is also a large car parking area located opposite the hotel with x2 EV chargers, the total site area is approximately 0.608 hectares (1.502 acres). Location Elen’s Castle Hotel is prominently situated on the A470 in the village of Dolwyddelan, set within the Lledr Valley at the heart of Snowdonia National Park, providing convenient access to the surrounding countryside and key visitor destinations. Dolwyddelan lies between Betws‑y‑Coed and Blaenau Ffestiniog, with the wider Betws‑y‑Coed area attracting visitors year round due to its extensive range of walks and treks. Dolwyddelan Castle is located on the outskirts of the village and is only a short walk from the hotel. The property sits at the foot of Moel Siabod, in a position between Betws‑y‑Coed and the Crimea Pass, making it a well placed base for exploring the national park. The hotel is also ideally located for regional attractions, including Zip World, Ffestiniog Railway and Antur Stiniog Mountain Bike Centre. The former coach house provides additional office accommodation, extending to approximately 63.82 sq m (687 sq ft) NIA. properties.description: A now cleared and secure site of about 0.41 hectares (1.02 acres) with frontage to London Road and Spring Gardens. The planning consent is for 88 flats that comprises: 37 x 1 bedroom apartments, 34 x 2 bedroom apartments, 15 x 3 bedroom apartments and 2 x 4 bedroom apartments, with a total gross internal area (GIA) of approximately 7,843 sq m (84,422 sq ft) over six floors. The consent also provides for 56 car parking spaces (9 allocated for DDA - Disability Discrimination Act) and 160 cycle spaces. Location Romford is a large, vibrant market town and commercial hub in East London, located 14 miles north-east of Charing Cross. Situated within the London Borough of Havering and London Fare Zone 6, it is celebrated for its historic 13th-century market, bustling nightlife, and excellent transport links. There is an abundance of open green spaces in the proximity of this site, that includes Cottons Park and Westlands Playing Fields. The Chase Nature Reserve and Family Golf and Leisure Park are also nearby. The surrounding area is mainly residential. The site is also well served by local schools, including Crowlands Primary School and also St Edwards Church of England Academy. The site occupies a prominent position on London Road with Spring Gardens. Frequent bus services from London Road serve the town centre and the train station. Road connections are also good with the nearby A12 connecting to J28 of the M25 to the east and M11 and A11 to the west. Planning London Borough of Havering (01708 433100) www.havering.gov.uk The property is to be offered with planning consent for the 'redevelopment of vacant former car park site to provide residential development of 88 self-contained units of part 4, 5 and 6 stories. Includes provision of communal amenity areas, parking, landscaping and access arrangements.’ Includes provision of communal amenity areas, parking, landscaping and access arrangements'. The second guarantoor, is also an experienced landlady, with 17 years experience in the trade, with three other venues of her own and is also a homeowner. archive.address: The Vaults, Manor Road, Chatham, Kent, ME4 6HW
archive.description: Lot 77 Land The Vaults Manor Road, Chatham, Kent, ME4 6HW Sold for £88,000 All A Collection of Three Vacant Domed Vaults and Tunnels Measuring Approximately 403 sq m (4,337 sq ft) Previously let for £25,000 Per Annum. Description The lot comprises a collection of three domed vaults and tunnels measuring approximately 403 sq m (4,337 sq ft) . Reputedly from the Napoleonic times and believed to have been munitions stores, the rooms and tunnels have until recently been tenanted and used for many years as a motorbike and car repair business. The access road known as Manor Mews (from Manor Road) is also included in the sale. The layout consists of three main domed rooms, each of which have entrance doors to the front and are connected at the rear through underground tunnels. Tenure Freehold Location The vaults are situated on a residential road close to local shops and amenities. The open spaces of Victoria Gardens are within easy reach. Transport links are provided by Chatham rail station. Accommodation Ground Floor Three Domed Vaults and Tunnels Measuring Approximately 403 sq m (4,337 sq ft) Note The vendor advises that the vaults were previously let for £25,000 per annum.
